entities.name: Jadwiga Wołoszyńska
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jadwiga Wołoszyńska was a Polish botanist known for studying algology, limnology, and paleobotany. She identified new types and species (e.g. Prorocentrum cassubicum Dodge of algae and studied lakes in Poland, Lithuania, Ukraine, Java, Sumatra and Africa The standard author abbreviation Wołosz. is used to indicate this person as the author when citing a botanical name.
